chunks: Abu Basir said to Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام: What amount of clothing is sufficient for a man to pray in?

So he said: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ali, blessings of Allah be upon him, prayed in a garment that had risen above half of his shin and came near his knees, and there was nothing of it upon his shoulders except the measure of the two wings of a swallow.

And when he bowed, it fell from his shoulders, and whenever he prostrated, his neck reached it, so he returned it to his shoulders with his hand. That remained his constant practice and occupation with it until he finished.

key_terms.الثِّيَابِ: garments or clothing worn for prayer
key_terms.دَأْبَهُ: his continual habit or repeated practice
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient or adequate for fulfilling the requirement

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum clothing sufficient for a man to pray in according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the minimum clothing sufficient for a man in salat (prayer) by citing the practice of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام. It indicates permissibility of praying in a small garment that covers the required area, even if it must be adjusted during the prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.788 - Abu Basir asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about what is sufficient clothing for a man to pray in.
Imam (as) said: "Hussain ibn Ali (as) prayed in a garment that reached up to half his shin and was close to his knees, with only as much covering on his shoulders as the wings of a swallow.
When he would bow (in ruku'), it would slip off his shoulders, and whenever he prostrated (Sujood), it would touch his neck, so he would pull it back over his shoulders with his hand, and this remained his practice until he completed the prayer”.
